faq: Will I lose my search rankings?

We keep your products, collections and page addresses the same, and we check for broken links before launch. No one can promise rankings, but a redesign that keeps your addresses and content in place is built to avoid the usual drops.
Does my live store stop while you work?
No. We build in a duplicate theme inside your account, so the live store keeps taking orders. When you approve the preview, we publish the new theme at a time that suits you.
Will my current apps still work?
We check each app against the new design and tell you which ones need changes. Most keep working as they are. If an app is no longer needed, we point it out so you can decide whether to remove it.
Do I need to supply a design?
No. Send your logo, brand colors and a few stores you like, and we propose a direction. If you already have mockups or a Figma file, we follow them and tell you what Shopify can and cannot do.

desc:
A Shopify store redesign for an existing store gives your shop a fresh, faster look while keeping your products, pages and web addresses intact. Ecom Swift LLC works in a duplicate theme, so your live store keeps selling until you approve the new design.

## What is a Shopify store redesign?

A Shopify store redesign is a rework of how your current store looks and feels, covering layout, typography, color, product pages, collections and navigation. It changes the presentation, not the underlying business. Your products, collections, blog posts and page addresses stay where they are.

That difference is what separates a redesign from a rebuild. You are not starting over. You are improving a store that already has customers, content and search history, so the work must respect what is already working.

## Why a redesign helps, and what can go wrong

Stores age. Trends move, your product range grows, and your brand becomes clearer than it was on day one. A dated or cluttered layout makes a good business look less credible, and shoppers judge that within seconds. Pages also pick up weight from years of apps and edits.

A careless redesign can cause harm. Changing page addresses breaks old links, deleting content removes pages that bring in visitors, and switching themes can silently remove app features. Working on a copy, with a link check before launch, avoids these traps.

## How design changes affect results

Good design directs attention. A clear first screen tells visitors what you sell, strong product pages answer questions before they are asked, and a simple menu gets shoppers to the right collection. Consistent typography and spacing make a store feel trustworthy and easy to read.

Faster, lighter layouts help too, because shoppers on phones reach products sooner. How much your results change depends on your products, prices and traffic, so we do not predict revenue. We design to remove friction and to make your brand look as good as your products.

## What a strong redesign includes

- A walk through your current store, its best pages and its weak points.
- A new home page layout with a clear message and clear paths into the catalog.
- Colors and fonts refreshed and applied consistently.
- Header, footer and navigation reworked so shoppers can find products quickly.
- Product pages redesigned for photos, variants, price and the buy button.
- Collection pages with sensible filters and sorting.
- Cart page and drawer styled to match.
- Custom sections you can edit in the theme editor.
- Blog, About and contact pages restyled to match.
- A link check against your old store, so nothing leads to an error page.

## How we do the redesign

We start by going through your store as shoppers see it and by listing what to keep, change and remove. You tell us about your brand, what you like and what you dislike. A design reference is welcome but not necessary.

We then duplicate your live theme and build the new design in the copy. Your live store continues as normal. We keep products, collections, posts and web addresses unchanged. Before launch, we check mobile layouts, compare links between the old and new versions and send you a private preview link. After your approval, we publish the new theme and, on the larger package, stay available for fixes. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in how many pages and custom sections are redesigned. Because apps may add code to the theme, we check each one in the new design so features keep working.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us which parts of the current store your customers like.
- Share two or three stores whose style you admire.
- Leave existing URLs and product titles as they are.
- Check the preview link on your phone before approving.
- Schedule go-live for a slow week so any hiccup costs you little.

**Avoid:**
- Redesigning and rewriting all product text in the same week.
- Adding many new apps during the redesign.
- Letting the old theme be deleted until the new one is stable.
- Packing the home page with banners, sliders and pop-ups.
- Approving a design without testing the cart and checkout.

## Who this is for

This service suits stores whose look no longer matches their brand, sellers who outgrew the theme they started with, and merchants whose pages feel crowded or slow. It also suits brands that have a steady flow of visitors and want a better design without risking their search presence.

## What we need from you

Send your store address, your logo and brand colors if you have them, and a few examples of designs you like. Invite us to your Shopify store as a collaborator, with theme permissions only. We never need your password. If you do not have a design, that is fine: we propose the direction and you approve it from the preview.
